source.content: Metadata.Layout x = new Metadata.Layout(); x.customButtons = new List<String>{'New'}; x.customConsoleComponents = new Metadata.CustomConsoleComponents(); x.emailDefault = true; x.excludeButtons = new List<String>{'Delete'}; x.feedLayout = new Metadata.FeedLayout(); x.headers = new List<Metadata.LayoutHeader>{Metadata.LayoutHeader.PersonalTagging}; x.layoutSections = new List<Metadata.LayoutSection>{new Metadata.LayoutSection()}; x.miniLayout = new Metadata.MiniLayout(); x.multilineLayoutFields = new List<String>{'Name'}; x.platformActionList = new Metadata.PlatformActionList(); x.quickActionList = new Metadata.QuickActionList(); x.relatedContent = new Metadata.RelatedContent(); x.relatedLists = new List<Metadata.RelatedListItem>{new Metadata.RelatedListItem()}; x.relatedObjects = new List<String>{'Account'}; x.runAssignmentRulesDefault = true; x.showEmailCheckbox = true; x.showHighlightsPanel = true; x.showInteractionLogPanel = false; x.showKnowledgeComponent = true; x.showRunAssignmentRulesCheckbox = true; x.showSolutionSection = false; x.showSubmitAndAttachButton = true; x.summaryLayout = new Metadata.SummaryLayout(); System.assertEquals('New', x.customButtons[0]); System.assertEquals(true, x.emailDefault); System.assertEquals('Delete', x.excludeButtons[0]); System.assertEquals('PersonalTagging', String.valueOf(x.headers[0])); System.assertEquals('Name', x.multilineLayoutFields[0]); System.assertEquals('Account', x.relatedObjects[0]); System.assertEquals(true, x.runAssignmentRulesDefault); System.assertEquals(true, x.showEmailCheckbox); System.assertEquals(true, x.showHighlightsPanel); System.assertEquals(false, x.showInteractionLogPanel); System.assertEquals(true, x.showKnowledgeComponent); System.assertEquals(true, x.showRunAssignmentRulesCheckbox); System.assertEquals(false, x.showSolutionSection); System.assertEquals(true, x.showSubmitAndAttachButton); System.assertNotEquals(null, x.clone()); System.debug('GLADE_METADATA_LAYOUT_BATCH:pass');
